sentences.text: The Gold Loan FAQ does not state any pre-payment charge percentage.

The Gold Loan FAQ says only that gold loans are loans granted against the security of gold ornaments pledged with the Bank, that the loan amount is a percentage of the assessed value of the gold ornaments, and that the tenure is up to 12 months.
The Retail Loan Policy says gold loans shall be governed by the Gold Loan Operational Guidelines of the Bank, which shall be read with the Policy.
